text:
maya_finance: Heads-up: NewCorp invoice #9187 ($23,600) autopay declined repeatedly. Customer on the line says corporate card was blocked by their treasury. Asking if we can accept immediate wire + confirm account details so they can release.
payments-bot: [AUTOPAY] invoice=9187 status=failed decline_code=do_not_honor attempts=3 next_retry=2026-05-02T09:00:00Z
diego_support: Do we have a secondary payment method?
riley_billing: No secondary. Card token shows `05` decline. Customer offered to push an immediate wire.
maya_finance: Because amount >$20k, flag to Sales/legal for PO match? But customer says PO is on file. We just need the wire so they can get blanket release. Any compliance flags?
riley_billing: We require a PO number in the wire reference or our AP won't auto-apply. Also get a screenshot of the bank confirmation (FedRef) and remit name.
diego_support: I'm confirming with customer: "We can accept wire today. Please include PO# in the reference and send a bank confirmation screenshot once remitted. We'll apply payment immediately and pause any service holds."
ops-oncall: Internal note: if international wire used, ensure SWIFT and intermediary bank details are included. If routing via correspondent bank, collect trace ID.
maya_finance: Drafting internal wire template (do not share SWIFT publicly):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Northbridge Commercial Bank (US)
Routing/ABA: 333000444
Account: 5556667778
SWIFT: NBCBUS33 (internal use only)
Reference: PO-4112 / INV-9187 / NewCorp LLC
Remit confirmation: settlements@redwood.com
```
riley_billing: Also add: "Please include payer legal name exactly as registered to avoid holds."
diego_support: Customer replied: "Will wire within 2 hours, PO-4112 attached, bank will email confirmation with FedRef."
maya_finance: OK. Creating ticket FIN-5012 for manual reconciliation. Once we see the FedRef, apply payment and disable autopay token. Notify Sales that payment path used.
payments-bot: [TICKET] FIN-5012 created: NewCorp manual wire for INV-9187.
ops-oncall: If wire posts but auto-match fails, escalate with FedRef and image to ops-oncall for manual allocation.
maya_finance: Thanks team 44d I'll update when funds hit. Closing once applied.
